actual_scope: Can the frame itinerary of one field of the #4610 word (research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022) be changed by free scalar rewiring so that two consecutive rank-1 climbs become one rank-2 climb (the H1+H1->H2 fusion priced by #5226 and targeted by #5243), in either orientation?
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a changed frame itinerary that removes a paid transition; #5226/#5243 made the concrete instance on the current word explicit (one fusion per native call would reach 0.0030220, five per call 0.0030233) and asked for a physical pair. This package answers that instance negatively for all free scalar rewirings of the frozen word.
bottleneck_link: Negative result: fragmentation Lambda of #4610 cannot be lowered by fusing rank-1 climbs without new frames or native maps; the staircase structure (each intermediate frame is the only meeting frame with a partner) is the obstruction, and any paid repair costs >= 1 against a gain of 0.0042.
stop_rule: Stop after the structural certificate (S1-S3, relocation test, controls) passes in both orientations and the exact row-level searches on the backward word finish; do not start a new native word or a helper-relation search.
evidence: verify.py binds the #4610 word by SHA256, replays the nested-climb contract, counts the 1363 pairs per orientation, certifies S1-S3 and 0 relocatable pairs, runs a positive control (deleting one main event makes one pair relocatable) and a negative control, and checks the price order; RESULT.json records the row-level searches (tools/compsearch.py: 0 of 1261 pairs; tools/cascade.py: 0 of 2522 pair-variants).
author: Mark (Matarener)
ai_assistance: Prepared with substantial Claude Code (Claude) assistance.

open_questions.question: Is there a native word in the (112, 8) family whose intermediate meeting frames are shared with the next climb target, so that fusions become legal?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Five fusions per call close the 0.0209 Lambda gap to 0.0030233 (#5226); on the frozen word none is legal, so only a changed word can use this lever.
open_questions.first_step: Take the per-field climb paths and partner frames exported by verify.py, and ask the MILP of research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/helper_line_milp.py for a frame assignment in which a partner's frame at the intermediate interaction is nested in the field's next target.
open_questions.blocked_by: A changed word must be re-admitted (native maps, phases, 632 endpoints); not attempted here.

open_questions.question: Do the 102 pairs with a warp between the two climbs admit a fusion if the warp is re-bound to the merged target frame?
open_questions.why_it_matters: They are the only pairs outside this certificate.
open_questions.first_step: List the 102 pairs with their warp operators and check whether the warp's from/to frames can be replaced by the merged frames while preserving the 72 native maps.
